plan.title: Single-stage RFQ title with special characters

steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow adding the QA vendor during event creation.
Change the default event type to RFQ.
Enter the title containing special characters.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Render and populate the pricing sheet for the line item.
Verify the requested product was selected.
Verify the product's variant was filled automatically.
Verify the requested quantity.
Choose the specified delivery location.
Verify the selected delivery location.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Commit the default Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached the project page.
Verify the project page retains the exact typed title.
Open the events list to verify the published event there.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Verify the exact special-character title appears in the events list.
Open the invited QA vendor portal session.
Open this event's overview in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor portal shows the exact same title.
